title: Tunisian Lamb Tagine
description: A traditional Tunisian stew made with lamb and spices, cooked in a clay pot with a conical lid.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a clay tagine or large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the onion and cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the lamb and cook, stirring occasionally, until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add the cinnamon, cumin, coriander, and tagine spice mix. Cook, stirring constantly, for 1 minute.
Add the chicken broth and bring to a boil.
Cover the tagine or Dutch oven and transfer to the oven. Braise the lamb, covered, in a preheated oven at 300°F (150°C) for 2 1/2 hours.
Stir in the parsley. Serve hot, with lemon wedges on the side.
Let the dish rest for 10-15 minutes before serving.
Garnish with parsley and lemon wedges, if desired.
